neighbours.label: HTML markup written inside source code: tag names and brackets such as 'span', 'option', 'td', ' <' in an HTML string
quiet: The span of the roof left no option but to add a third beam.

notes: Card: 'span' x5, 'option' x2, 'td' x2, ' <' x2 in HTML fragments embedded in Python, plus 'Delete' / ' search' / ' error' as UI words in code.
